newsitem.title: USA: IXC sees Q2, FY EBITDA below estimates.
newsitem.headline: IXC sees Q2, FY EBITDA below estimates.

text.p: IXC Communications Inc said it is expecting revenues and earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization for the second quarter and the year to be below its previous estimates.
The company said earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization for its switched services business has continued to be negative and is likely to remain negative for rest of the year.

"Consequently, the company expects its revenues and EBITDA for the second quarter and the year will be below its previous estimates. The company now believes that 1997 EBITDA will be in the range of $20 million to $30 million, and 1998 EBITDA will be $125 million or more," IXC said Wednesday evening.

It attributed the problems in its switched services business to two factors. It said the switched traffic generated by its long distance customers has been comprised of a higher mix of minutes originating or terminating in high access cost Local Access Transport Areas than anticipated.
Additionally, uneven traffic patterns across its switch network has created high network overflow costs, it said.

The company said it is trying to bring positive cash flow to the business through an intensive examination of traffic distributions, identification of customers generating an unprofitable mix of traffic and adjusting contract terms where necessary.

Other steps include pre-screening new contract proposals to evaluate the financial impact of expected traffic distributions and added switch capacity to cut the cost of network overflow traffic, it said.

The company said these efforts could slow the growth rate of switched services revenue but should provide steady improvement in switched service operating results for the remainder of the year and in 1998.
